title: Wellness
tagline: Massages in the garden, or in your suite.
body: Amandine and Eve, our resident therapists, offer a range of treatments — deep tissue, relaxation, and signature rituals — designed to restore you completely. Book a session on arrival and forget everything outside the walls.

title: The Leroy Brothers Studio
tagline: Visit the artists behind the artwork.
body: Nicolas, Gilles, and Gregory Leroy maintain a working studio near the property. Subject to availability, guests can arrange a private visit to see the current body of work in progress.

title: Electric Bikes
tagline: Explore the hills at your own pace.
body: Two Moustache electric bikes are available for guests. The terrain around Saint-Paul de Vence is hilly and beautiful — ride to neighbouring villages, through the vineyards, or along the coast road.

title: The Pools
tagline: Three for everyone. Four more that are entirely yours.
body: Seven pools are scattered through the gardens — three shared, four private to specific suites. This is the place to read a book, work on a tan, and let conversations happen at their own pace.
